citations.quote: Frost Armor: Sejuani gains bonus armor and bonus magic resist, as well as slow immunity and cripple immunity.

Sejuani gains Frost Armor, which lingers for 3 seconds after taking damage from enemy champions, turrets, or large monsters. She restores it after 12 – 5.29 (based on level) seconds without taking damage from them.

claims.claim: Frost Armor grants bonus armor, magic resist and immunity to slows and attack-speed reductions; it lingers briefly after damage and recovers after a break from relevant damage.

citations.quote: Enemies stunned by Sejuani are also marked Frozen at the same time. Her next basic attack or ability against a Frozen target will consume the mark to deal bonus magic damage based on their maximum health.

claims.claim: Enemies Sejuani stuns become Frozen, letting her next attack or ability consume the mark for magic damage based on their maximum health.

evidence.verification_scope: Exact citations/structural checks; no new AI verifier or editorial approval

importance.reason: Explains her initial durability and damage follow-up after stuns.

row.answer: Frost Armor grants bonus armor, magic resist and immunity to slows and attack-speed reductions; it lingers briefly after damage and recovers after a break from relevant damage. row.question: What does this ability do?

citations.quote: Sejuani throws an ice bola in the target direction that stops upon hitting an enemy champion, dealing magic damage and briefly stunning them.

claims.claim: Glacial Prison throws a bola that stops at the first enemy champion, dealing magic damage and stunning them.

citations.quote: If the bola travels far enough, it becomes empowered to detonate upon reaching max range or hitting an enemy champion, gaining increased damage and stun duration.
a frost storm is created around the location of the detonation that slows enemies within by 30%
After 2 seconds, the storm shatters to deal the increased magic damage to enemies within and slow them by 80% for 1 second

claims.claim: After sufficient travel, it gains damage and stun duration and detonates on a champion or at maximum range, creating a slowing storm that later bursts for magic damage and a stronger slow.

citations.quote: The enemy hit by the bola is unaffected by the storm's effects.

claims.claim: The champion hit by the bola is unaffected by the storm.

evidence.verification_scope: Exact citations/structural checks; no new AI verifier or editorial approval

importance.reason: Her ranged engage and delayed area damage strongly influence positioning.

row.answer: Glacial Prison throws a bola that stops at the first enemy champion, dealing magic damage and stunning them. After sufficient travel, it gains damage and stun duration and detonates on a champion or at maximum range, creating a slowing storm that later bursts for magic damage and a stronger slow. The champion hit by the bola is unaffected by the storm.
row.counterplay: Sidestep the bola, spread out and leave the storm before it bursts.
